title: Resolve Magazine Fall 2025: Next-gen robotics
body: Resolve features David Saldaña and Cristian-Ioan Vasile’s NSF CAREER research. Saldaña’s project combines adaptive control and reinforcement learning to help aerial robots manipulate flexible objects such as cables, rods, hoses, and sheets.

title: NSF Discovery Files: A new world of collaborative aerial robots
body: David Saldaña joins NSF’s Discovery Files podcast to discuss resilient and adaptive aerial robots and how they can collaborate with people and other robots.
imageAlt: NSF Discovery Files podcast: Collaborative Aerial Robots

title: NSF CAREER Award: From nature to complex aerial manipulation
body: PI David Saldaña receives the NSF CAREER Award to advance aerial robotics capable of manipulating flexible objects and adapting to shifting forces in midair.

title: Lehigh robotics team soars to victory at Defend the Republic
body: Lehigh Swarms wins the Fall 2024 Defend the Republic drone competition at Indiana University, demonstrating the team’s progress in autonomous robotic blimps.

title: Lehigh CHOICES program with Swarmslab
body: A hands-on introduction to robotics engineering for middle-school girls through the Lehigh CHOICES program.

title: NSF funds a cable-based approach to aerial robotics
body: David Saldaña and Subhrajit Bhattacharya receive a three-year, nearly $600,000 NSF grant to develop aerial robots that use cables, knots, and hitches to grasp and transport objects.
imageAlt: David Saldaña and Jiawei Xu working with aerial robots in Lehigh’s AIR Lab

title: Our robotic blimp on the cover of Resolve
body: SwarmsLab’s robotic blimp appears on the cover of Resolve’s Spring 2024 issue, Taking Flight, which highlights robotics research and student opportunities at Lehigh.
imageAlt: Spring 2024 Resolve magazine cover, Taking Flight, featuring a SwarmsLab robotic blimp

title: Resolve Magazine Spring 2024: Advancing Autonomy
body: Resolve explores SwarmsLab’s research on aerial manipulation using cables, knots, and hitches, alongside the lab’s role in the Defend the Republic competition and opportunities for students in aerial robotics.

title: Defend the Republic Spring 2024
body: Lehigh Swarms won MVP at DTR Event 8 among ten universities. Mochi 3.0 demonstrated autonomous collaborative capturing and scoring.

title: Defend the Republic Fall 2023
body: SwarmsLab hosted seven other universities at Lehigh’s Mountaintop campus for the fall blimp competition.

title: Defend the Republic
body: Lehigh’s team qualified ahead of the other teams and placed third in its second appearance at the blimp competition.

title: FIRST WORKSHOP ON ROBOT VERSATILITY 2022
body: A day of talks, posters, and demos at Lehigh AIRLab, featuring five invited research presentations.

title: Resolve Magazine Spring 2021 Issue
body: Resolve Magazine visits the Autonomous and Intelligent Robotics Laboratory on Lehigh’s Mountaintop campus.

title: Communications of the ACM: Saving lives with aerial drones
body: Communications of the ACM features ModQuad, our modular aerial robots that dock and self-assemble in midair.
imageAlt: ModQuad modules flying together in connected formations

title: ModQuad on Discovery Channel
body: Our research team demonstrates ModQuad on Discovery Channel Canada’s Daily Planet. Watch the trailer featuring our self-assembling modular aerial robots.
imageAlt: Thumbnail from the ModQuad Discovery Channel trailer
